paragraphs.text: 1. I LAUD your Mighty One who joyeth in the juice, him who is shared by all men, who created all;
paragraphs.original: प्र वो महे मन्दमानायान्धसोऽर्चा विश्वानराय विश्वाभुवे ।
paragraphs.translit: pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhaso'rcā viśvānarāya viśvābhuve |

paragraphs.text: Indra, whose conquering strength is powerful in war, whose fame and manly vigour Heaven and Earth revere.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रस्य यस्य सुमखं सहो महि श्रवो नृम्णं च रोदसी सपर्यतः
paragraphs.translit: indrasya yasya sumakhaṃ saho mahi śravo nṛmṇaṃ ca rodasī saparyataḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. He with his friend is active, lauded, good to man, Indra who must be glorified by one like me.
paragraphs.original: सो चिन्नु सख्या नर्य इन स्तुतश्चर्कृत्य इन्द्रो मावते नरे ।
paragraphs.translit: so cinnu sakhyā narya ina stutaścarkṛtya indro māvate nare |

paragraphs.text: Hero, Lord of the brave, all cars are thy delight, warring with Vrtra, or for waters, or for spoil.
paragraphs.original: विश्वासु धूर्षु वाजकृत्येषु सत्पते वृत्रे वाप्स्वभि शूर मन्दसे
paragraphs.translit: viśvāsu dhūrṣu vājakṛtyeṣu satpate vṛtre vāpsvabhi śūra mandase

paragraphs.text: 3. Who are the men whom thou wilt further, Indra, who strive to win thy bliss allied with riches?
paragraphs.original: के ते नर इन्द्र ये त इषे ये ते सुम्नं सधन्यमियक्षान् ।
paragraphs.translit: ke te nara indra ye ta iṣe ye te sumnaṃ sadhanyamiyakṣān |

paragraphs.text: Who urged thee forward to exert thy power divine, to valour, in the war for waters on their fields?
paragraphs.original: के ते वाजायासुर्याय हिन्विरे के अप्सु स्वासूर्वरासु पौंस्ये
paragraphs.translit: ke te vājāyāsuryāya hinvire ke apsu svāsūrvarāsu pauṃsye

paragraphs.text: 4. Thou, Indra, through the holy prayer art mighty, worthy of sacrifice at all libations.
paragraphs.original: भुवस्त्वमिन्द्र ब्रह्मणा महान्भुवो विश्वेषु सवनेषु यज्ञियः ।
paragraphs.translit: bhuvastvamindra brahmaṇā mahānbhuvo viśveṣu savaneṣu yajñiyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: In every fight thou castest heroes on the ground: thou art the noblest song, O Lord of all the folk.
paragraphs.original: भुवो नॄँश्च्यौत्नो विश्वस्मिन्भरे ज्येष्ठश्च मन्त्रो विश्वचर्षणे
paragraphs.translit: bhuvo nṝm̐ścyautno viśvasminbhare jyeṣṭhaśca mantro viśvacarṣaṇe

paragraphs.text: 5. Help now, as Highest, those who toil at sacrifice: well do the people know thy great protecting might.
paragraphs.original: अवा नु कं ज्यायान्यज्ञवनसो महीं त ओमात्रां कृष्टयो विदुः ।
paragraphs.translit: avā nu kaṃ jyāyānyajñavanaso mahīṃ ta omātrāṃ kṛṣṭayo viduḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thou shalt be everlasting, Giver of success yea, on all these libations thou bestowest strength.
paragraphs.original: असो नु कमजरो वर्धाश्च विश्वेदेता सवना तूतुमा कृषे
paragraphs.translit: aso nu kamajaro vardhāśca viśvedetā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe

paragraphs.text: 6. All these libations thou makest effectual, of which thou art thyself supporter, Son of Power.
paragraphs.original: एता विश्वा सवना तूतुमा कृषे स्वयं सूनो सहसो यानि दधिषे ।
paragraphs.translit: etā viśvā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe svayaṃ sūno sahaso yāni dadhiṣe |

paragraphs.text: Therefore thy vessel is to be esteemed the best, sacrifice, holy text, prayer, and exalted speech.
paragraphs.original: वराय ते पात्रं धर्मणे तना यज्ञो मन्त्रो ब्रह्मोद्यतं वचः
paragraphs.translit: varāya te pātraṃ dharmaṇe tanā yajño mantro brahmodyataṃ vacaḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. They who with flowing Soma pray to thee, O Sage, to pour on them thy gifts of opulence and wealth,
paragraphs.original: ये ते विप्र ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा वसूनां च वसुनश्च दावने ।
paragraphs.translit: ye te vipra brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā vasūnāṃ ca vasunaśca dāvane |

paragraphs.text: May they come forward, through their spirit, on the path of bliss, in the wild joy of Soma juice effused.
paragraphs.original: प्र ते सुम्नस्य मनसा पथा भुवन्मदे सुतस्य सोम्यस्यान्धसः
paragraphs.translit: pra te sumnasya manasā pathā bhuvanmade sutasya somyasyāndhasaḥ
